public.prompt: Fill four holes in the procurement skill AND fulfill every round's real market requests. Each round demands one whole case of either tea or cocoa; a case fills the entire cold store. Buying the wrong product loses that service contract irreversibly. Quotes reveal economic terms, not demand. Use the public candidate-world table and any suitable observations to decide what to buy. Choose either supplier; the final cash goal allows one express surcharge in total. Complete 3 rounds with all requests served and cash at least 6973 cents. No particular sensor or observation count is required for scoring. Read /market/contract.json, /skills/procurement.txt and /docs/accounting.txt.

standard_lead_days.description: Standard shipping lead time in days.

fixed_shipping_cents.description: Fixed standard shipping fee per order.

case_shipping_cents.description: Additional standard shipping fee per indivisible case.

receipt_event.description: Event that makes invoiced goods physically available.

quote.description: Hypothetical itemized quote. Static terms; no current/future demand is revealed.

calibrate.description: Once per episode, before an order, observe the shared forecast calibration bit.

forecast.description: Use this round's single diagnostic sample to observe its coded forecast bit.

assay.description: Alternative diagnostic sample: observe the current demanded-product bit directly.

order.description: Pay for one indivisible case, irreversibly. One case fills storage. Invoice creates pending stock; no stock is available yet.

settle.description: Advance to this round's day-2 market: receive deliveries, serve requests, dispose leftovers and pay the operating fee.

status.description: Repeat the full public observation and accounting totals; no new latent information.

ledger.description: Read prior invoices, deliveries, sales, expiry and fees. No future events.

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
